name: usage-ledger-primary-reported-total
title: Surface cache-less-provider (codex/gemini) tokens in usage-ledger aggregates via an additive primaryReportedTotal
description: Provider-reported codex/gemini token records are captured on disk (B-12d7) but never appear in any usage-ledger aggregate, because the strict four-field identity buckets every record with a null cache dimension as unknown. Add a NEW additive primary (input+output) aggregate to summary.ts and diagnostics.ts so these tokens become visible, without inferring any value the provider did not report and without changing the strict four-field providerReportedTotal semantics.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive (mention, not modify): the keyword "token" refers to LLM usage TOKEN COUNTS (input/output token metering in the usage ledger), not authentication tokens, credentials, or secrets. This story only adds an additive input+output aggregate to informational-only summary.ts/diagnostics.ts; it touches no auth, secrets, keys, or headers. The record schema forbidden-field denylist (apikey/secret/authorization/etc.) is untouched.
